title: Balance the paths
goal: out reads (a XOR b) AND b, settled within 2 ns. b reaches the AND sooner than a XOR b does, so out may flicker before it settles. A buffer is stocked to make the early path as long as the late one: where it goes decides whether out still settles in time.
hint: the path through two gates is the slow one. Delay the other, never this one.
